biography.plain_text: Gary Norton is an American entrepreneur who made his first fortune in banking technology after founding Spokane-based International Systems Corporation. After selling the computer-systems business, he created Silverwood Theme Park in northern Idaho. He developed a private airfield and transport collection into a regional visitor attraction that remained independently operated for nearly four decades.

long_biography.plain_text:
Outbidding the Walt Disney Company for a 1915 steam locomotive gave Gary Norton the centrepiece for a transport museum at his Idaho airfield. The idea grew into Silverwood Theme Park, which opened in 1988 and gradually added major rides, a water park and seasonal entertainment around its original railway and aviation theme.

Norton's practical involvement survived the park's expansion. He helped shape new attractions and personally revised workforce-scheduling software, coding around weather, staffing and seasonal demand. His enthusiasm for vintage aircraft also reached the flight line: early visitors watched him perform aerobatics in a Second World War-era P-51 Mustang.

uncertainties.detail: The stored LinkedIn URL uniquely connects this record to Gary Norton at Silverwood in Athol, and independent business profiles match the company history, geography and age. The full middle name Allen appears in the immutable record, while a historical company index independently supplies only the initial A. The combined chain supports identity at 91 confidence but does not treat name alone as sufficient.

The immutable age of 72 on 7 May 2020, age 64 reported in August 2012 and age 75 reported in June 2023 are mutually consistent but leave a birth window spanning late 1947 and early 1948. No strong source establishes the exact day, month, year or place of birth, so none is proposed.

Norton sold ISC in the late 1980s and Herschend completed its acquisition of Silverwood in March 2026. No strong public source identifies how the later proceeds were allocated or which retained private assets now predominate. Primary industry and wealth relationship therefore remain Unknown rather than assuming finance, hospitality or founder ownership.

The creation of ISC and Silverwood is well established, but reliable sources do not describe Norton's family wealth, launch capital or other starting platform closely enough to distinguish an independent from an advantaged start. Broad Self-made is retained. No spouse or family asset is inferred.

The existing LinkedIn URL is verified by its Silverwood role and Athol geography. No Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was verified through an official cross-link or two strong independent sources, and the former Silverwood company website is not proposed as a current owner website after the sale.

Biographies exclude all vessel facts, transaction values, volatile attendance and revenue figures, private family details, spouse or family wealth, politics, legal disputes, controversies and sensitive material. Nothing has been compiled or applied.
